name: sherpa
description: Composable /frame, /shape, /implement skills — one per layer (macro, shape, build) — plus /analyze, /triage, /restory, and /invoke skills for analyzing, triaging, reconstructing story context, and running pack skills, with adversarial review at every boundary. The user composes the workflow; opt-in /persist for state.

interface.shortDescription: Composable frame, shape, implement, analyze, triage, and restory layers
interface.longDescription: Adds opt-in Sherpa skills — /frame (scout, bind an intent), /shape (draft the plan, then critique it), /implement (build with per-step review), /analyze (pre-review analysis), /triage (reason about and route all PR review feedback), /restory (reconstruct story context), /invoke (run a pack skill or any markdown file as a skill) — that the user composes into a workflow. Nothing persists unless you call /persist.
defaultPrompt: Use /frame to shape this fuzzy task.
Use /shape to draft and critique the plan.
Use /implement to build the approved plan.
Use /triage to reason about and route all PR review feedback.
